content:
# Carousel

Merry-go-round: spinning horses under a striped canopy, from the RCT2 sprite.

Built with three.js on the shared Stage; modelled from the authentic RCT2 sprite.

# FerrisWheel

Ferris wheel with A-frame supports and gondolas that stay upright as they orbit.

Built with three.js on the shared Stage; modelled from the authentic RCT2 sprite.

# Teacups

Spinning tea-cups flat ride: a turntable of cups that each spin on their own axis.

Built with three.js on the shared Stage; modelled from the authentic RCT2 sprite.

# BumperCars

Dodgems: a fenced arena with a powered ceiling grid and four darting cars.

Built with three.js on the shared Stage; modelled from the authentic RCT2 sprite.

# PirateShip

Swinging pirate ship on a pivot arm between two towers.

Built with three.js on the shared Stage; modelled from the authentic RCT2 sprite.
